description: This file defines CLI command options and functions to invoke gateway calls with progress indication in a TypeScript project related to OpenClaw. It specifies command-line options, a helper to attach options to a command, and an async function to call the gateway with those options.

methods.name: gatewayCallOpts
methods.description: Sets up command-line options for the 'Command' object related to gateway connection parameters.

methods.name: callGatewayCli
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes the gateway call with the specified method, options, and parameters, displaying progress.

ctags.name: callGatewayCli
ctags.pattern: /^export const callGatewayCli = async (method: string, opts: GatewayRpcOpts, params?: unknown) =>$/
